# Blackpool

> Private payments that leave no trail: zero-knowledge privacy pools on Robinhood Chain, Base, Arbitrum and BNB Chain. Shield funds once, then send, swap or bridge them with no on-chain link back to your wallet. Agents use the `@blackpool/cli` command-line tool with JSON output.

## For agents
- [AGENTS.md](https://blackpool.cash/AGENTS.md): complete guide for AI agents and scripts — setup, every CLI command, JSON output fields, chains, fees and minimums, bridging, recipes, integration code (Node, Python, tool definition), errors, retry rules, security.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@blackpool/cli): `npm i -g @blackpool/cli`
- MCP: local server `npx -y @blackpool/cli@latest mcp` (payments, key stays local); hosted read-only server `https://mcp.blackpool.cash/mcp` (status, fees, assets, quotes, analytics, guide)
